references.supports: C# interfaces express capabilities/contracts and can be implemented across unrelated class hierarchies; existing class implementations can remain in place when a compatible interface default supplies the new operation.
Default interface members provide method bodies, and implementing types may provide a more specific implementation.
CS8701 documents that target-runtime support for default interface implementation is a distinct concern from language-version support; the v2 stem explicitly supplies that runtime premise.
